scope: Development evidence only; no independent transfer improvement established. Reference RGB geometry, scale and light/material decomposition are not uniquely identifiable.

direct_gt_queries.observations: All three actual blends were opened in Blender 5.2.2; queried object matrices, parent relationships, mesh material slots and UV layers, material node graphs including groups and links, image paths and packing, cameras and lights. Each camera is perspective, lens 15 mm and sensor width 32 mm. S02 includes a packed image; image inventories and graph details are in outputs. These are implementation observations, not proof of optimality or visible improvement.
